versions.changelog:
Initial launch of Shopify Checkout skill as CreditClaw, supporting guardrailed wallets and multiple payment methods.

- Added support for multiple payment rails: Pre-paid Wallet, Self-Hosted Card, and Stripe x402 Wallet.
- Modular documentation split into Amazon, Shopify, general shopping, payment rails, and heartbeat/balance check files.
- Security and approval features for agent spending with owner visibility and permissions.
- New, more robust skill registration and environment variable guidance.
- Deprecated and removed single-purpose SKILL.md in favor of a multi-file, comprehensive skill suite.
